Emily - AE: Acme POC kickoff Monday. They want hosted API keys with 2wk window, auto-rotate every 48h, and immediate revocation. Need a playbook and any security caveats.
Raj - SE: Do they want ephemeral OIDC or hosted keys we manage?
Emily - AE: They asked for hosted keys we rotate server-side; no OIDC for the POC.
Sam - CloudOps: We can create project-scoped hosted keys with TTL=48h, auto-rotation job, and end-date auto-revoke. We support per-key CIDR allowlist and a one-time download link for the initial secret.
Marta - Security: Confirm audit trail and redaction. For POCs we keep logs 90 days. We can redact key values but creation/rotate/revoke events are recorded. If they require keys in their KMS, that’s a Private offering.
Raj - SE: Can rotation failures fall back to a read-only token so they don't lose reads?
Sam - CloudOps: Yes — we have a fallback policy: route to a rate-limited read-only token on rotation failure. Enable at key creation.
Emily - AE: Need a short checklist and curl snippets I can send them.
Sam - CloudOps: Checklist: 1) Create project in Console, enable 2FA on AE account. 2) Create hosted key with scopes [generate, embeddings], ttl=48h, allowlist=Acme CIDRs. 3) Enable auto-rotate + fallback read-only token. 4) Share one-time download link with customer. 5) Set POC end-date auto-revoke.
Sam - CloudOps: Revoke example:
```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.com/v1/keys/<KEY_ID>/revoke" -H "Authorization: Bearer $INTERNAL_TOKEN"
```
Sam - CloudOps: Rotate example:
```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.com/v1/keys/<KEY_ID>/rotate" -H "Authorization: Bearer $INTERNAL_TOKEN"
```
infra-bot: audit event: key.create user=Sam project=acme-poc key_id=k_02AbC (log:/audit/2024/2240012345.log) :white_check_mark:
Marta - Security: Approve pending confirmation on log export cadence. If Acme asks for KMS or longer retention, pitch Private (sales uplift).
Emily - AE: Perfect, I'll share this with Acme and request their CIDRs. Thanks all :thumbsup:
